title: Fat Lip
lyrics:
[00:19.61]Storming through the party like my name was El Niño
[00:21.71]When I'm hanging out, drinking in the back of an El Camino
[00:24.28]As a kid, was a skid and no one knew me by name
[00:26.66]Trashed my own house party 'cause nobody came
[00:29.10]I know I'm not the one you thought you knew back in high school
[00:31.88]Never going, never showing up when we had to
[00:34.25]Attention that we crave, don't tell us to behave
[00:36.63]I'm sick of always hearing, "Act your age"
[00:38.61]I don't wanna waste my time
[00:40.98]Become another casualty of society
[00:43.73]I'll never fall in line
[00:45.87]Become another victim of your conformity
[00:48.64]And back down
[00:58.77]Because you don't
[01:01.18]Know us at all, we laugh when old people fall
[01:03.42]But what would you expect with a conscience so small?
[01:05.85]Heavy metal and mullets, it's how we were raised
[01:08.60]Maiden and Priest were the gods that we praised
[01:10.76]'Cause we like having fun at other people's expense then
[01:13.49]Cutting people down is just a minor offense then
[01:15.84]It's none of your concern, I guess I'll never learn
[01:18.16]I'm sick of being told to wait my turn
[01:20.17]I don't wanna waste my time
[01:22.56]Become another casualty of society
[01:25.33]I'll never fall in line
[01:27.45]Become another victim of your conformity
[01:30.16]And back down
[01:40.99]Don't count on me
[01:43.92]To let you know when
[01:45.89]Don't count on me
[01:48.82]I'll do it again
[01:50.75]Don't count on me
[01:53.60]It's the point you're missing
[01:55.62]Don't count on me
[01:58.61]'Cause I'm not listening
[01:59.49]Well, I'm a no goodnick lower-middle-class brat
[02:02.16]Back packed and I don't give a shit about nothing
[02:04.58]You'll be standing on the corner talking all that kufuffin
[02:07.05]But you don't make sense from all the gas you be huffing
[02:09.36]'Cause if the egg don't stain
[02:10.76]You'll be ringing off the hook
[02:11.79]You're on the hit list
[02:12.80]Wanted in the telephone book
[02:14.30]I like songs with distortion
[02:15.60]To drink in proportion
[02:16.80]The doctor said my mom should've had an abortion
[02:26.20]I don't wanna waste my time
[02:28.62]Become another casualty of society
[02:31.31]I'll never fall in line
[02:33.48]Become another victim of your conformity
[02:36.22]And back down
[02:36.58]Waste my time with them
[02:39.11]Casualty of society
[02:41.49]Waste my time with them
[02:43.91]Victim of your conformity
[02:46.01]And back down
